compatibility: Opt-in new envelope; existing abacus-binary-bridge/v1 output and CLI are unchanged. Consumers must explicitly recognize the new schema.

identity.content_id: sha256:<exact input byte hash>; deduplication key only
identity.occurrence_id: sha256 of byte hash plus receipt_id, ordered container chain, exact member path and member index
identity.legacy_source_id: Old basename, retained as a label only; never a unique join key
identity.member_index: Actual zero-based archive central-directory occurrence index, or 0 for a non-archive source within a unique receipt
identity.container_chain: Outermost to innermost. Each entry carries exact bytes SHA256, original member_path and member_index. No path/case normalization.

fallback_pdf.unverified_page_marker_estimate: Legacy marker-based estimate only, never a validated page count

coverage.rule: Requested depth is not evidence of completed depth. Every existing upstream family has explicit uncovered surfaces.

authority.rule: Source authority/lifecycle strings remain claims. Caller supersedes values become unverified lineage candidates. No parsing or confidence score approves source authority.

preconditions: Archive admission and source custody are upstream responsibilities
Exact upstream source bytes must pass the pin before import
Source file size must not exceed 256 MiB
Caller supplies an actual occurrence context; no context is inferred from basename
CLI output must not alias the source, occurrence-context file or upstream bridge; resolved paths and existing-file identity are checked before parsing or writing
integration_residuals: The adapter does not write repositories, create branches or PRs, publish releases or dispatch federation work
The adapter is not a deep parser, OCR engine or archive scanner
Upstream pin changes require explicit source review and targeted verification
Final accepted namespace must align with the parent's common intake/navigation contract
